Replayed finite program verified 134 coefficient/moment checks, 24 detuning checks and 631 generator flux-balance checks; these are supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: At a natural nonequilibrium steady-state condensation threshold, the number of degenerate slow sites governs a complete chi_r family for the onset mass, independently partitioned by a Dirichlet law; two sites give a Rayleigh rather than half-normal law. The multivariate weak-rate deformation resolves competing defects at a distinct critical square-root scale, connecting the observed density window and fixed-mass asymmetry physics. The exact joint law and parameter-dependent crossover are mathematically motivated observables with prospective use for finite-size defect statistics.
